title: Session handoff 2026-11-19: QCLI-322 round 2 awaiting verdict; 567 (held, launcher), 449, 446, 568, 563 next
description:
STATE, read live at handoff (2026-11-19T04:09:05Z). origin/dev carries the DEC-282 (a1) carriers as 88cab3f5 (#740). origin/main e0a559dd, the v0.15.0 tag peel; package.json reads 0.15.0 on dev and main. npm latest is 0.14.1 on both @opum-ai/quest and @opum-ai/lore with 0.15.0-rc.1 on release-candidate, so the 0.15.0 pair is STILL UNPUBLISHED and the holds stand (QCLI-547/551/554, hold-labelled). lore-cli main reads 0.15.0 at 7b617684, so the publish-parity precondition stays met on their side.

#741 (QCLI-322) IS OPEN AND NOT MERGED. Round 1 was REQUEST_CHANGES at 3e81cf590e24 with two blockers; round 2 landed both and is at head 4180cb6c917b85111800ff4ee9a8859594486580 on branch feat/QCLI-322-alias-collision-input. B1: collision attribution moved from a key-keyed map to per candidate OCCURRENCE (AliasCollision.index, occurrence-aligned candidateSources); a new e2e cross-family test asserts family, verdict and both retries, and was proved to bite by restoring the old lookup. B2: the three unchanged-message claims corrected (remedy paragraph byte-identical, first sentence gains the occupant clause on a destination claim). N1-N6 taken along: doc section moved after the preserve-source-ids coverage paragraph, preservation-mode origin/occupant documented, probe failures can no longer replace the conflict, positional gloss widened, per-family runs and the families limitation documented. AC position 6 checked with the ODOC-607 note. A FRESH review worktree is at .claude/worktrees/review-741-4180cb6; the round-1 one, review-741-3e81cf5, also stays (DEC-208). Do not merge before a verdict.

QCLI-555 is In Progress at 3/4 ACs with #723 merged; its AC1 (a test driving the REAL receipt gate through the tarball route) stays open under QCLI-558, per its own note and the Opus review N1. Leave both untouched unless the leader says otherwise.

MY QUEUE, in the leader order: QCLI-567 (item 7, HELD -- launcher terms), QCLI-449, QCLI-446, then QCLI-568 and QCLI-563.

QCLI-567 (DEC-282 (a1) item 7) is a DEFECT and the most urgent of the (a1) set: the node wrapper must never orphan the native child. bin/quest.cjs is DEC-182 (1) LAUNCHER class by the leader ruling (same as lore bin/lore.cjs): sonnet-or-higher implementation, OPUS security review, no DeepSeek at any step. It carries the hold label. Target bin/quest.cjs and its tests; the wrapper currently uses spawnSync in the same process group, which is why a caller timeout that kills only the wrapper leaves the native binary running.

QCLI-449 (seq 179e) is the prompt.submit capture behind a captureRequests setting. It was STOPPED at the fence: the design requires the Quest board mod to hook prompt.submit (.claude-plugin/plugin.json userConfig plus hooks/register.tsx), which is the plugin-manifest and install-or-session-hook class, so it needs a sonnet-tier session. Design read by ref at opum-doc origin/main 6c4051a1 in docs/reference/questions-decisions-and-adrs.md ("Requests: the other direction"), NOT the operator-questions doc the task description names -- that one is silent on capture. Four design silences were routed to opum-doc: the request title, whether origin.kind bridge counts, whether the setting is project-scoped, and who adds request to opum-docs task vocabulary.

QCLI-446 waits on a sonnet-tier route for the same reason: it implements the forgery guard in hooks/register.tsx, a DEC-182 (1) hooks class.

QCLI-568 (item 8) and QCLI-563 (item 5, re-scoped to a build) are the across-refs work, both To Do, QCLI-568 depending on QCLI-563. Both must ship with items 1-4 in the next lore/quest pair release.

HOW TO WORK HERE: quest is on PATH at 0.14.1. Tracker writes need --actor quest-cli --actor-kind delegated-agent --accountable-human jdnewhouse, and tracker prose goes in SINGLE quotes because double-quoted backticks execute. Read the clock with date -u immediately before writing any timestamp into a note; estimating it has cost three corrections already (two in this session). bun local is 1.3.14 while package.json pins bun@1.4.2; /opt/homebrew/bin/bun is 1.4.4 and is what makes the QCLI-411 check pass. Docs are lore-managed: lore replace for edits, lore check exit 0 is the gate. Land tracker-only changes and task PRs the same way: bare gh pr merge <n> --squash --delete-branch --match-head-commit <full sha read from gh pr view --json headRefOid>, after source-gates, Tracker integrity and lore check are completed/success on the head with NO pending row of a required context; a source-touching head produces TWO source-gates rows. NEVER compose a full SHA from its short form -- that produced a GraphQL "Head branch was modified" refusal this session.

LOCAL CHECK CAVEAT: bun run check exits 1 locally in this session on test:mods TYPECHECK arm only, because loading the plugin-authoring skill writes a 2.1.326 claude-code.d.ts that the mods own Placement type predates. The 1402-test suite and the 45 mod runtime tests pass, and tsc, biome lint, format and layers are green. CI source-gates is the authority for that arm.

WORKTREES: do not remove, deregister or prune any (DEC-208, LCLI-740 open). Every review-* worktree stays.

CAMPAIGN METHOD: close a task only after re-reading its record; the task id in a close note must name the task that INTRODUCED a mechanism, not the one in flight. Citations are quoted from the ref they were read at; opum-doc main is not dev.
